sql: SELECT 'game_matches_total' AS metric, count(*)::text AS value FROM game_market_matches UNION ALL SELECT 'game_matches_active', count(*)::text FROM game_market_matches WHERE status='active' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_tape_total', count(*)::text FROM game_tape_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'ladder_favband_last1h', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE yes_ask_cents BETWEEN 65 AND 90 AND captured_at > now() - interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_runs_last_15m', count(*)::text FROM bot_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
